decision_contract: predict close(t+20)/close(t) using only feature rows preceding t; no same-close execution assumption
monthly_rate_policy: Exactly one monthly-period lag as requested: month M observation becomes eligible at 00:00 JST on the first day of M+1, then forward-filled to Tokyo trading dates. Never backfill initial missing dates. This is a lag convention, not verified historical release timestamps.
checks: one-month lag, no backfill, no earlier effect from future monthly observations
all source-availability bounds precede Tokyo target cutoffs
future perturbation cannot affect past features
all input dates strictly before target dates
data_limit: Yahoo/FRED/OECD histories are not point-in-time vintage databases. Audit verifies calendar causality under declared availability bounds, not historical vendor revisions or exact intraday publication timestamps.
